summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the supplier/ERP data drops, find where the launch plan hides shortfalls, and build a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, verifier, decision cards, routines, voice, push) with a calm Today-flow UI.
summary.outcome: Found the hidden Collector's Edition and game-card risks, prepared briefing docs and an interview doc, and built and committed a full pipeline and calm Today UI (email review, routines as diagram/editor, voice two-step, verifier fix to 6,800 short). Work is pushed on branch jonas/today-flow; the last restyle/automation front end commit was in progress at the end.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, state, store); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed with an empty token.

Portal API has only list files, get file and archive.zip, no webhooks or change feed. Change detection requires polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, since files are replaced under the same name.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md require claiming a task in PROGRESS.md; Entire hooks checkpoint only when repo files change and push checkpoints on git push.

Verifier shortfall counts inbound only when a supplier shipping document confirms it; unread documents are conservatively not counted. The image recognizer may put part numbers in 'item' rather than 'material_id', needing a fallback in doc-line mapping.
Routines created before the recipe switch are code-only and cannot render a diagram; new routines are recipes and default to 'ask' mode.
Voice decisions now use a two-step prepare/decide flow with a one-time token; decide is answered locally unless the person spoke since the last prepare.

code.finding: Each part carries 'arriving' and 'not_counted' lists; gap = needed - usable - arriving. Arrival rules cover ETA, cancellation, receipts, overdue and shipped-vs-ordered quantity.
Wide view was rewritten into When/Then/Always lanes; narrow vertical view kept. Later the Flow/Steps/Expand toggles were merged into one diagram-as-editor.
Today flow with Focus view, email review dialog before sending, source sheet, done/undo view and routine proposals; undo is dropped for sent emails since they cannot be recalled.

workflow: Delegating whole front-end areas to single builder subagents with disjoint file ownership avoids edit conflicts; verify with screenshots using mocked POSTs so no real emails go out.
Ask before paid API calls and before actions that send real supplier email; viewing live state with screenshots without clicking is safe.
Check for doc edits before updating a shared Claude doc, and use the Artifact/Docs tools for briefings kept private.

friction: Hooks seemed not to fire because Entire skips checkpoints when no repo files change.
Dashboard initially showed 34,800 game cards short because the shipping advice had no local reading; needed a paid recognizer run plus a mapping fix.
Standard stop time was misattributed to the Hwaseong card instead of the clear cases at the port, requiring an attribution fix.
The UI offered Undo after an email was sent, which was misleading; the first voice flow said it would outline and then just decided.
Legacy code-only routines showed failures and no diagram; the three diagram views (Flow, Steps, Expanded) were redundant.
Phone approval of a no-cost option sends a real supplier email immediately.
